analysis.title: US Equities: Daily Short Activity (11/20/2026)
key_insights: GS Securities Lending daily short flow (ex-ETFs) was +1.1% day/day as of 11/20/2026. The ETF-level and sector charts are reported only as plotted values.

Sector short flows by 1-day short change: Materials +2.3%, Comm Services +2.0%, Health Care +0.4%, Technology +0.1%, Energy +0.1%. Financials, Industrials and Utilities were each -0.1%. Real Estate was -0.6%, Consumer Discretionary -0.9% and Consumer Staples -1.4%.

Top shorted industries by percent change: Metals & Mining +3.4%, Interactive Media & Services +2.7%, Air Freight & Logistics +2.6%, Textiles, Apparel & Luxury Goods +1.6%, Health Care Providers & Services +1.4%.
Top covered industries: Tobacco -6.1%, Specialty Retail -4.5%, Beverages -3.7%, Household Products -1.8%, Consumer Finance -1.7%.

Top shorted GC (general collateral) names by market value of short change: WMT (+11.6% short, -1.0% price), GOOGL (+4.1%, -3.5%), PANW (+7.1%, +6.4%), AMD (+1.8%, -7.7%), BE (+5.2%, -1.7%), ALAB (+17.6%, -2.4%), CRWV (+8.3%, -6.1%), KO (+6.2%, -2.0%), TMO (+6.1%, -0.6%), DECK (+12.3%, -5.6%).
WSM shows the largest price drop among the top covered GC names (-15.2%) alongside a -7.3% short change. PANW rose 6.4% while shorts increased 7.1%.

Custom baskets: Most Short Rolling (GSCBMSAL) covered -3.2%, Memes (GSCBHRSB) shorted -3.3%, Liquid Most Short (GSXUMSAL) covered -3.1%, Long Quality (GSXUMFQL) shorted -3.2%, AI At Risk (GSTMTAIR) covered -3.3%.
crypto_views: Crypto-linked equities in the custom baskets and non-GC lists: MSTR short change 0.0% (price -4.6%), MARA +0.5% (price -4.8%), CIFR +1.5% (price -1.4%) in the top shorted non-GC list, and CRCL +3.3% (price -2.7%) in Financials.
risk_factors: Data comes from a subset of aggregated GS client positions and is not inclusive of all market positions, per the disclosures.
Some short-flow and price figures in the document come from external vendors that GS has not verified.
vol_and_positioning: Daily short flow ex-ETFs was +1.1% day/day. The sector-level aggregate short flow was +0.1% day/day.
Shorts were added in PANW, AMD, ALAB, CRWV, DECK and WMT, while AAPL, KR, V, PM and WSM were covered.
Top-shorted and top-covered lists are built from GS prime brokerage and securities lending data, a subset of GS client activity, and are not a full market view.
Short selling increased in AI infrastructure and neocloud names: ALAB +17.6%, CRWV +8.3%, NBIS +6.1%, DDOG +13.3%, with prices down in CRWV (-6.1%) and NBIS (-9.4%).
Within the AI At Risk basket (GSTMTAIR), constituents APPF, CNXC and DXC were covered, with DXC -7.2% on price.
